kernels.title: GF(2^8) arithmetic of crates/kernels (xtime, add, mul)
kernels.specification: WideTrail GF256.xtime and GF256.rawMul on BitVec 8, the multiplication of the field GF256

kernels.title: Parametric AES-like round and multi-round encryption of crates/kernels
kernels.specification: Cryptificate.aesLikeRound, Cryptificate.aesLikeExec, and the final-round variant Cryptificate.aesLikeFinalRound and Cryptificate.aesLikeCipher, of the main Lean package (lean/Cryptificate/Bridge.lean) over WideTrail GF256

kernels.title: Active-S-box bound of the AES-like kernel of crates/kernels for any design, conditionally on three kernel-evaluable checks on its bytes
kernels.specification: Cryptificate.activityBound and the active-S-box count of the main Lean package, with the design checks minors4Ok (canonical minors), distinct offsets and a byte table covering every value as hypotheses

kernels.title: Active-S-box bound of the AES-like kernel of crates/kernels for AES, with no design hypothesis

appliesTo.design: AES: MixColumns [02 03 01 01 / 01 02 03 01 / 01 01 02 03 / 03 01 01 02] row-major, ShiftRows offsets [0 1 2 3], FIPS 197 S-box table

kernels.specification: Cryptificate.activityBound and the active-S-box count of the main Lean package for the byte arrays aesMatrixBytes, aesOffsetBytes and aesSboxBytes, identified with the main package encodings gfMat4 2 3 1 1 1 2 3 1 1 1 2 3 3 1 1 2, offsets4 0 1 2 3 and the FIPS 197 table aesSboxTable, equal to WideTrail AES.sbox
